sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 SAM negative: push missing a required field is refused (400)
sys_atf_test.description: validateInboundPush must refuse a push missing any of sam_request_id, access_item, requested_for or approval_authority, and name every missing field — not just the first.

sys_atf_step.description: A push missing access_item and approval_authority fails validation and names both.
A field present but blank/whitespace-only counts as missing — the check trims before testing truthiness.
An empty push body is refused outright (the endpoint reads request.body.data and passes null through if absent).
